## Personality

Bertha Shirley possessed a talent for writing charming and personal letters. Her written words and thoughts successfully captured her attractive personality, retaining their beauty and fragrance even over time.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## History

Bertha Shirley was deeply in love with her husband when they married, and the couple spent an exceptionally happy, though brief, life together. Having rarely been separated from her husband during their courtship, Bertha passed away not long after her marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P19](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0019), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--bertha-shirley.md)

Bertha Shirley was the parent of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) knew very little about her mother until visiting her birthplace in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), where she received a bundle of old letters written by Bertha and her husband. Reading these letters allowed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to feel a genuine personal connection to her mother for the first time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P11](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0011), +3 more_
